hypothesis: Fabric response clauses improve believable motion

Soft directional window light shapes the face. Foreground, midground, and background create depth. Hasselblad camera, 85mm lens, 8K masterpiece, ultra-detailed. Avoid bad anatomy, extra fingers, blur, artifacts, text, watermark, logo.

variants.text: The satin responds to the hip turn with delayed folds and a slight trailing hem movement.
